question: How many countries have gini recalculated lower than the world average in 2015?
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country) FROM country_income WHERE year = 2015 AND gini_recalculated < ( SELECT AVG(gini_recalculated) FROM country_income WHERE year = 2015 );
answer: 92 countries had a recalculated Gini index lower than the world average in 2015.
